verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general facility for user-defined rules that trigger actions on events, such as event rules, triggers, or automation policies. Auto-pay balance reload and serverless scale-to-zero are fixed, single-purpose behaviors, so they count only as adjacent features. The REST API, CLI, and MCP servers are building blocks a user could script against, not a rules engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
